portal_hypertension.title: Machine learning-derived clinical phenotypes of ascites in cirrhosis: A multi-center latent class analysis with external validation.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver transplantation : official publication of the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the International Liver Transplantation Society
portal_hypertension.authors: Cullaro G, Lai JC, Liu T
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 625）。核心观点：肝硬化腹水使五年生存率从 80% 降低至 30%，但腹水严重程度相当的患者之间存在很大的异质性。 临床提示：这项多中心回顾性队列研究包括美国四个中心（2015-2024 年）患有腹水的成人肝移植候选者。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Ascites development in cirrhosis reduces five-year survival from 80% to 30%, yet substantial heterogeneity exists among patients with comparable ascites severity. This multicenter retrospective cohort study included adult liver transplant candidates with ascites at four United States centers (2015-2024). Latent class analysis was performed using seven clinical variables: ascites grade, bilirubin, albumin, platelet count, estimated glomerular filtration rate, systolic blood pressure, and portal vein thrombosis. portal_hypertension.title: VITRO score dynamics after liver transplantation predict portal-hypertensive events and post-transplant mortality.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver transplantation : official publication of the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the International Liver Transplantation Society
portal_hypertension.authors: Dominik N, Dinjar Kujundzic P, Kristandl F
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝移植（LT）后门静脉高压（​​PH）很少见，但与并发症和死亡率相关。 临床提示：VITRO 评分（结合血管性血友病因子抗原 (vWF) 除以血小板计数 (PLT)）反映了肝硬化中 PH 的严重程度，但其在 LT 后的预后价值仍不清楚。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension (PH) after liver transplantation (LT) is rare but associated with complications and mortality. The VITRO score - combining von Willebrand Factor antigen (vWF) divided by platelet count (PLT) - reflects PH severity in cirrhosis, yet its prognostic value after LT remains unknown. VITRO score dynamics and clinical outcomes were evaluated in 272 consecutive adult patients with available vWF-Ag measurements undergoing LT between 2016 and 2022 at the Medical University of Vienna. Laboratory parameters were assessed at listing, pre-LT, and at 3-6 and 12 months post-LT. Endpoints included overall mortality and a composite endpoint of PH events and/or liver-related death within 12...

portal_hypertension.title: Robotic Whole-graft Liver Transplant: Lesson Learned And Outcomes After 45 Cases.
portal_hypertension.authors: Di Benedetto F, Magistri P, Coelho JS
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：机器人肝移植（RLT）代表了实体器官移植的最新发展。 临床提示：虽然早期报告证明了全移植物 RLT 的技术可行性，但以既定标准为基准的临床结果证据仍然有限。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Robotic liver transplantation (RLT) represents the latest evolution in solid organ transplantation. While early reports demonstrated technical feasibility of whole-graft RLT, evidence on clinical outcomes benchmarked against established standards remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate perioperative post-transplant outcomes of whole-graft RLT and to assess whether benchmark performance can be achieved in clinical practice. This retrospective multicenter cohort study included consecutive patients undergoing whole-graft RLT at 2 European centers between February 2024 and October 2025. Preoperative, perioperative, and follow-up data were retrieved from prospectively maintained databases. ...

portal_hypertension.title: Comparison of underdilated versus standard transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt in preventing rebleeding from oesophagogastric varices in patients with cirrhosis in Chinese tertiary hospitals: protocol for a multicentre randomised controlled trial (UVR-TIPS trial).
portal_hypertension.authors: Liu L, Wei B, Zhang F
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床试验（样本量约为 648）。核心观点：肝性脑病（HE）是经颈静脉肝内门体分流术（TIPS）放置后的主要并发症，显着影响患者的生活质量和长期预后。 临床提示：本研究旨在比较扩张不足的 TIPS 与标准 TIPS 在预防肝硬化门脉高压患者静脉曲张再出血方面的功效，并评估术后 HE 的发生率。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatic encephalopathy (HE) is a major complication following transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) placement, significantly affecting patients' quality of life and long-term prognosis. This study aims to compare the efficacy of underdilated TIPS versus standard TIPS in preventing variceal rebleeding in patients with cirrhosis and portal hypertension and to evaluate the incidence of post-procedural HE. This multicentre randomised controlled trial will be conducted across five Grade A tertiary hospitals in China. portal_hypertension.title: Slc26a9 guards gastric mucosa against portal hypertension by reducing ER stress-induced apoptosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ma Z, Yi Z, Ji B
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：在这项研究中，人类 PHG 样本显示 Slc 显着降低... 临床提示：Slc26a9是Slc26a家族的成员，在胃中高表达，是维持胃粘膜稳态的关键调节因子。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Slc26a9 is a member of the Slc26a family that is highly expressed in the stomach and is a key regulator for maintaining gastric mucosal homeostasis. Slc26a9 deletion in mice impairs the gastric mucosal barrier. However, the role of Slc26a9 in PHG has never been investigated. Slc26a9 expression was analyzed in human PHG and control gastric tissues. A PVL-induced PHG model was established in Slc26a9 fl/fl and parietal cell-specific Slc26a9 knockout mice to evaluate mucosal injury, ER stress, and apoptosis.
